author: Peattie, Mark R.
title: Sunburst: The Rise of Japanese Naval Air Power, 1909–1941
notes: The companion to source:evans-peattie-1997 on naval aviation: the carriers, the aircraft, and above all the aircrew training programme, which was superb, tiny, and never replaced — the fact behind the difference between the Japanese carrier force of 1942 and the one of 1944. Cite it for the technical and doctrinal background to Pearl Harbor, Midway and the Philippine Sea.
